name: The Black-Rent Book
description: Annet Blackrent's book of the black-rent, kept in a careful Rudd hand: every farm under the passes, what it paid each autumn for twenty years, and in a column of its own the farms that did not pay, and what was done. Isbel ko-Rudd's farm is on the third page, twelve years paid, and this year blank.

name: Mother Scree's Binding-Cord
description: A cord as thick as a thumb, plaited of grey hair, every hag's in the warren, and knotted along its whole length with knots of a hundred kinds. It is cold, and when it is held still it tightens a little in the hand, as if it were still tying something.

name: The Cut Link
description: A link of old chain-iron as long as a hand, sawn through on one side and sprung open. The clan-mark of Ghast is struck on it, and a name scratched under the mark has been filed away to a bright smear: only the first letter is left, a K.

name: A Skarl Coffin-Token
description: A disc of giant's bone pierced for a cord, of the kind the Skarl nail to a coffin's lid so the Breath knows whose it is taking. This one was in the broken boards at the foot of the Breath-Ledge. The name on it is Aldo ko-Skarl.

name: A Shard of Giant's Tooth
description: A splinter of a giant's tooth as long as a forearm, yellow-white, ridged like a cockle-shell along its grinding edge. The bone-carvers of Kharrow pay well for it; the clans say it is bad luck to sell one you dug up yourself.

name: The Corbie Riders' Tally
description: A riders' tally-board of split birch, kept in the strongroom under Corbie Stack.

name: A Bone-Warden's Last Count
description: A bone-warden's tally-book, the last pages, found in the hags' warren under the Unmade Giant.

name: Bannoch's Swarm-Book
description: A bee-master's book of swarms put into the boles and where they went.

name: Grett's Turn-Board
description: The Bucket-Line's tally-board of turns walked in the wheel, with notes cut beside them.

name: The Kite-Watch Line-Log
description: A kite-wife's log of how the kites flew, and what the lines felt.

name: Ottar's Link-Count
description: The Kinchain smith's count of the links closed in a year, and for whom.
